upscaling.options.title: Upscaling
upscaling.options.enabled.tooltip: Off renders the world at native resolution with no upscaler.
upscaling.options.upscaler.tooltip: FSR 4 needs the Vulkan graphics API and fsr4vk (see the mod's README). Without them it falls back to Bilinear.
upscaling.options.renderScale.tooltip: Resolution the world is rendered at before upscaling. 100% (Native AA) renders at full resolution and uses FSR only as anti-aliasing.
upscaling.options.sharpness.tooltip: RCAS sharpening applied to the FSR 4 output. Has no effect with the Bilinear upscaler.
